title: Complete shadcn/ui theme token migration
description: Migrate all Tailwind class usages from legacy Tahoe tokens to shadcn/ui naming conventions. Phase 1 (additive CSS variables) is done — this covers Phase 2 (component migration) and Phase 3 (cleanup).

tasks.title: Migrate text color classes across all components
tasks.description: Bulk rename legacy text hierarchy to shadcn equivalents

tasks.title: Migrate bg-surface-* classes to shadcn equivalents
tasks.description: Replace surface staircase with shadcn surface tokens

tasks.title: Switch @theme inline from backward-compat to full shadcn mapping
tasks.description: Once components are migrated, change --color-primary from var(--text-primary) to var(--primary), --color-secondary from var(--text-secondary) to var(--secondary), --color-muted from var(--text-muted) to var(--muted). This enables proper bg-primary/bg-secondary/bg-muted usage.

tasks.title: Update retro.css theme to define new shadcn variables
tasks.description: Add --foreground, --card, --popover, --primary, --secondary, --muted, --accent, --sidebar-*, --code-*, --selection-*, --chart-* variables to the retro theme so it doesn't fall back to dark theme values.

tasks.title: Remove legacy Tahoe tokens after full migration
tasks.description: Once all components use shadcn naming, remove --text-primary, --text-secondary, --text-muted, --text-dim, --surface-lowest through --surface-highest, and their @theme inline registrations from dark.css, theme.css, retro.css, and _base.css.

tasks.title: Deduplicate glass utilities between theme.css and glass.css
tasks.description: Glass utility classes (.glass-panel, .glass-button, etc.) exist in both theme.css and glass.css. Remove them from theme.css since glass.css is the canonical location imported separately.
